source: Isolated real PostgreSQL, NestJS, Next.js and signed OIDC provider
checks: Tenant OIDC configuration is permission-protected, live-discovered and stores only an authenticated client-secret envelope
Authorization Code plus PKCE validates signed ID-token claims, consumes hashed state once, links an existing member and creates real session cookies
Authenticated self-service disconnect requires the current local password, retains the binding lifecycle and revokes other sessions
Explicit account linking persists a distinct expiring intent, revalidates the signed provider proof and can reactivate only the same user binding
OIDC callback replay is rejected after the database transaction is consumed
JIT provisions a real user and tenant membership only at the configured low-privilege role for the exact verified domain
JIT rejects a verified provider email outside the tenant DNS trust boundary and persists no user
